title: Pages needed
prompt: Write pages_needed(items, per_page) returning how many pages are needed to show all items (per_page >= 1); zero items need zero pages.
teacher_lesson: Use divmod for page counts; a float is not a count.

mock.label: MOCK — scripted student, not a model
mock.first_attempt:
def pages_needed(items, per_page):
    return items / per_page
